title: Chicken Fajitas
desc: Spiced chicken breast with charred capsicum and onion, in mini tortillas.

portions.J: 4 mini tortillas, 220 g raw chicken, half the veg
portions.P: 3 mini tortillas, 140 g raw chicken, half the veg

ingredients.name: Fajita spices (smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, oregano, chilli)

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the spices, half the oil and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Char the veg
steps.text: Very hot pan or barbecue plate. Cook the capsicum and onion with the rest of the oil until soft and charred at the edges. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Same pan, high heat. Cook the chicken strips in one layer, turning once, until browned and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Squeeze the lime over the chicken and veg. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and load them up with the salsa and sauce.

notes: Swap a tortilla each for shredded lettuce to cut about 75 kcal.
